messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. If you need the current time, you can check a reliable world‑time website, use a smartphone clock set to the Eastern Time Zone, or run a quick command on your computer such as:

```bash
TZ=America/New_York date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
```

That will give you the present local time in New York.
